title: Per-Prediction Uncertainty Is Not a Regime Detector: A Detectability Bound and Two-Level Deployment for Cross-Sectional Equity Rankers
abstract: arXiv:2611.27992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantitative finance is increasingly exploring AI-native and agent-mediated allocation: when should an allocator trust a cross-sectional ranker after a silent regime shift that volatility controls miss? Aleatoric scaling addresses market noise; it does not detect epistemic invalidity when ranking structure breaks without a volatility footprint. Building on Sanderink (2026), "When Alpha Breaks" (arXiv:2603.13252), which established per-stock epistemic uncertainty, rank-geometry coupling, and a two-level gate on a walk-forward LightGBM US AI-exposure panel, this paper asks whether per-stock scores can be pooled into portfolio-wide health, or whether strategy-level abstention must condition on realised outcomes. RQ1 (Separation): Does epistemic uncertainty capture model-specific failure distinct from volatility? RQ2 (Decision value): Does a two-level architecture beat baselines on risk-adjusted return and drawdown? RQ3 (Robustness): Do answ

translated_title: 逐预测不确定性并非市场机制转变检测器：面向横截面股票排序模型的可检测性界限与两级部署方案
translated_abstract: 量化金融正日益探索AI原生与智能体中介的资产配置：当波动率控制指标未能捕捉到一次无声的市场机制转变后，资产配置者何时应当信任横截面排序模型？偶然不确定性的缩放处理的是市场噪声；它无法在排序结构断裂且没有波动率痕迹时检测认识论层面的失效。基于Sanderink (2026) 的 "When Alpha Breaks"（arXiv:2603.13252）——该工作在走前式LightGBM美国AI暴露面板上确立了逐股票认识论不确定性、排序几何耦合以及两级门控机制——本文提出的核心问题是：逐股票的分数能否被聚合为组合层面的健康状况，还是策略层面的弃权决策必须以已实现的结果作为条件。RQ1（可分性）：认识论不确定性是否捕捉到了不同于波动率的模型特定失效？RQ2（决策价值）：两级架构在风险调整后收益和最大回撤方面是否优于基线方法？RQ3（稳健性）：相关结论是否……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对横截面股票排序模型给出了可检测性界限，证明逐预测的认识论不确定性并不能充当市场机制转变的检测器，并据此提出策略层弃权必须以已实现结果为条件的两级部署架构。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a detectability bound demonstrating that per-prediction uncertainty is not a regime detector for cross-sectional equity rankers, and proposes a two-level deployment in which strategy-level abstention must condition on realized outcomes.
